profile.headline: Software Engineer at STV
profile.summary: Aspiring software developer and engineer with combined academic and professional experience updating and designing innovative web applications to optimize workflow on a global scale. Intuitive team leader adept at leveraging communication strategies to foster cross-functional collaboration amongst team members and achieve organizational goals. Analytical problem solver skilled at identifying inefficiencies and implementing process improvements to maximize user accessibility of web and mobile applications.

positions.title: Mobile/Web Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Collaborated with a senior engineer tasked with researching and rapid prototyping VR and AR solutions that could scale and delivered to customers without exceeding a $350,000 budget

• Leveraged React Native and Viro to build virtual overlays of products within customers’ physical space

• Created strategic and demo presentations with live demos to relevant internal business stakeholders

• Automated internal tech servicing and item request pipeline from manually managed spreadsheets to an automated web portal
     - Decreased overall submission errors by 20%, which reduced additional time overhead by ~ 10% for around 10,000 requests per year
     - Implemented with React, Redux for state management, React-final-form and Material UI

positions.title: Student Supervisor at Damen Student Center
Damen Student Center Event Services Member
Mobile Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Updated existing application to optimize end-user accessibility, converting QR code scanners and installing new data features that import contact information and produce personalized QR codes
- Utilized Swift and ObjC backed by XCode to modify existing code into cleaner and relevant Swift/SwiftUI design practices

• Developed new code for existing applications to streamline operational functions while decreasing deployment time, successfully increasing application downloads by
1K+ after launch
